text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Yukino Bijin was incredible! To be
honest, I
had no idea she could run like
that.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Well, she did run in the Oka Sho and the

Japanese Oaks. Anyone who can do
that's gotta
be strong.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I know! Everyone's so nice here.
choice_data_list: You got a lot of applause out there.
You got a lot of applause out there, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I guess runn'n well's all I have to worry
about.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I must've looked pretty conf'dent out
there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yep. 'Member how y'helped me relax
before the
race?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
After releas'n all that stress, I feel like I
was able
to really be m'self out there.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm... really proud of what I did t'day.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: Keep that momentum going for the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Yukino is such a cutie. With looks like
that, she's
just gonna get more and more
popular from here.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of, did you see the plushie
they just
released? I've gotta get me
one!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for sure! We should bring them to
her next
race too! I'm on this hype train
to all the way!
Choo choo!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win the Shuka Sho!
